principle: Operational limits are owner-adjustable defaults. Only authorization, external access control, cryptographic integrity, master-stop, secret/privacy protection and untrusted-code isolation may be hard boundaries.

classifications.control: Exact owner-reviewed scope JSON: max_requests, timeout_seconds, max_response_bytes
